name: Bounce Cards
description: Fanned row of overlapping image cards that pop in with a springy bounce, then push neighbors aside and lift the hovered card forward. Supports click and keyboard activation.
contents: Fixed-size container holding one square image card per entry in images
Cards with white border, rounded corners and soft shadow
behavior: Cards scale in from zero with a spring bounce, staggered after an initial delay
Cards settle into a fanned layout with alternating rotations and optional arc
Hovering or focusing a card straightens, lifts and enlarges it, brings it to front and pushes other cards sideways
Click or Enter/Space triggers onCardClick(index) with a small squash bounce
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by skipping pop-in and using stiffer movement
Animation loop sleeps when everything is at rest
editableByProps: Images, alt text and number of cards
Container and card size, spread, rotation, arc and per-card transforms
Hover enable, push distance and hover scale
Border width and color, corner radius, shadow on or off
Click handler, className and inline style overrides

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the rotation sequence of the fan

needsCodeEdit.where: popStiffness and moveStiffness values inside the frame function
--bounce-cards-shadow values in the root style object

fixed: Requires client rendering ('use client') and Tailwind CSS classes
Layout is horizontal and centered, cards positioned absolutely around the container center
Hover detection is by horizontal distance to nearest card slot, not per-element events
Cards are square with object-cover images
Custom transformStyles only parse rotate(Ndeg) and translate(Npx, Npx) strings
Intro animation runs once on mount; hover and click tilt are not configurable beyond props
